format.description: `csv`: UTF-8 text with a header row. `json`: an array of objects.

filter.description: A filter as JSON text, for example `{"location.name":{"eq":"XTD1"}}`. A condition names a field of the collection, one of the system fields `id`, `robot_id`, `created_at`, `updated_at` and `created_by`, or a field of a referenced record written `reference.field`. `created_by` is compared with the id of the developer, user or key that created the record.

search.description: Words that must all occur, in any letter case, in at least one searchable field of the record. At most 10 words, separated by whitespace.

sort.description: Up to 3 fields separated by commas; a leading `-` sorts descending, for example `-position_m,name`. A field is named as in `filter`: a field of the collection, one of the system fields `id`, `robot_id`, `created_at`, `updated_at` and `created_by`, or `reference.field`. Ties are broken by `id`.

robot.description: Only the records of this robot, in a collection that belongs to robots.

fields.description: The fields to export by key, separated by commas, in the order given. Default: all fields, in the order of the schema.

references.description: How reference fields are written: `id` (the default) or the key of a unique field of the target collection, such as `name`, so that the file can be imported again. A reference field in the file whose target collection has no such unique field is `400 validation_error` (field `references`, rule `not_unique`); with no reference field among the columns the value is ignored.

system.description: `true` adds the system fields after the fields: `robot_id` in a collection that belongs to robots, then `id`, `created_at`, `created_by`, `updated_at`, `updated_by` and `revision`. `created_by` and `updated_by` are the actors' labels. Default `false`.
